description: Access-control core: split guardian write access from read access (PRC-L314), gate break-glass requests to staff roles (PRC-L311), add role gating to screening-program CRUD (PRC-L315), fail closed on actor-institution-lookup errors (PRC-L312), extend field-ACL redaction to counselling outcome (PRC-M273), and fix break-glass grant-model integrity (PRC-L113: no-op-returns-200 + mutate-on-read + approver-scope invariant). This is the highest-priority, foundational slice — every later audit-write fix (FEAT-002) touches approve/deny and the write-gate helper this creates.
steps: PRC-L314: In packages/backend/health/src/health-service.ts, add an exported pure function hasHealthWriteAccess(context, studentId, options) next to hasHealthAccess that mirrors it but does NOT short-circuit true on context.guardianOfStudentIds.includes(studentId) — go straight to the hasAuthorizedRole / isTenantWideHealthActor / institution-scope checks. Add a private async assertHealthWriteAccess(accessContext, studentId, tenantId) mirroring assertHealthAccess but calling hasHealthWriteAccess and throwing ForbiddenError on failure.

PRC-L314: Replace the assertHealthAccess call with assertHealthWriteAccess at every mutating call site in health-service.ts: createMeasurement/updateMeasurement/deleteMeasurement, createAllergy/updateAllergy/deleteAllergy, createCondition/updateCondition/deleteCondition, createVaccination/updateVaccination/deleteVaccination, createInsurance/updateInsurance/deleteInsurance, createAssessment, createDiagnosis, createReferral/updateReferral, createAccommodationPlan/updateAccommodationPlan, createCounsellingSession/updateCounsellingSession. Do NOT touch listCounsellingSessions or any get*/list*By* read method — those keep assertHealthAccess unchanged.

PRC-L311: Change requestBreakGlass in health-service.ts to call assertHealthWriteAccess instead of assertHealthAccess (break-glass request is a staff-only workflow; guardians already see non-redacted reason and never see caseNotes without an approved grant, so this is a safe tightening).

PRC-L314/L311 tests: create packages/backend/health/src/health-write-authz.test.ts. Failing-first case: a HealthAccessContext with guardianOfStudentIds:[studentId], roles:[] calling service.createMeasurement/updateAllergy/deleteCondition/createReferral/updateCounsellingSession/requestBreakGlass must reject with ForbiddenError (this currently passes — demonstrate the pre-fix behavior in a comment or a temporarily-reverted check if useful, then assert post-fix rejection). Positive controls: the same guardian context must still succeed on read methods (getMeasurement-equivalent, listAllergiesByStudent) unchanged, and a school_nurse with correct institution scope must still succeed on all the write calls above.

PRC-L315: In health-service.ts, add accessContext: HealthAccessContext as a parameter to createScreeningProgram, updateScreeningProgram, deleteScreeningProgram, getScreeningProgram, listScreeningPrograms, listScreeningProgramsByGrade. At the top of each, throw ForbiddenError unless hasHealthAccess(accessContext, '') is true (reuses the existing tenant-wide-list-surface branch already used by listNurseIncidents/listAllVaccinations — requires an authorized health role + tenant-wide status; no institution scoping, since ScreeningProgramEntity has no institutionId field).

PRC-L315: In packages/backend/health/src/routes.ts, update all six screening-program route handlers (POST /screening-programs, GET /screening-programs including the gradeLevel-filtered branch, GET /screening-programs/:id, PUT /screening-programs/:id, DELETE /screening-programs/:id) to call getAccessContext(request) and pass it as the new service-method parameter.

PRC-L315 tests: add to health-write-authz.test.ts or a new screening-program-authz.test.ts: roles:[] or roles:['teacher'] calling any of the six screening-program methods must reject with ForbiddenError (failing-first). Positive control: health_officer or health_admin context succeeds on all six.

PRC-L312 (narrow codeable slice only — do NOT implement the broader 'fail closed on every institution-lookup error' scope, that is NEEDS_DECISION): in packages/backend/health/src/pg-actor-institution-assignments.ts, remove the catch { return null; } in findActorInstitutionAssignments and let it re-throw. In health-service.ts's resolveAuthoritativeInstitutions, wrap the lookup call in try/catch: on a caught error, if the actor is NOT tenant-wide (isTenantWideHealthActor is false), return { ...accessContext, authoritativeInstitutionIds: [] } (denies school-bound actors instead of falling back to JWT claims); if tenant-wide, return accessContext unchanged. Keep the existing 'lookup function absent entirely' early-return (if (!lookup || !accessContext.userId) return accessContext;) untouched — that legitimate 'not attempted' case still defers to JWT claims.

PRC-L312 test: add to packages/backend/health/src/health-institution-authz.test.ts (or a new file) a case using a repository stub whose findActorInstitutionAssignments throws, asserting a school_nurse context with a JWT institutionIds claim that would otherwise grant access is DENIED once the lookup throws (failing-first: before the fix the JWT fallback grants access). A second case confirms a tenant-wide health_admin is unaffected by the same thrown error.

PRC-M273: In health-service.ts, generalize the existing canReadCounsellingReason/redactCounsellingReasons pair to also blank the outcome field using the identical predicate (guardian-of-student OR counsellor role). Extend redactCounsellingReasons<T> to additionally blank an outcome: string|null field when present (or rename to redactCounsellingSensitiveFields if that reads more clearly) and update its 3 call sites unchanged in location: updateCounsellingSession, listCounsellingSessions, exportStudentDsarPackage.

PRC-M273 test: add to health-service.test.ts or a new counselling-outcome-acl.test.ts: a school_nurse/health_officer (not guardian, not counsellor) reading via listCounsellingSessions must get outcome:'' (failing-first — raw outcome returned today). A counsellor or the student's guardian must see the real outcome (positive control). Cover updateCounsellingSession's returned entity too.

PRC-L113 sub-issue 2 (no-op returns 200): in packages/backend/health/src/pg-break-glass-store.ts, change approve() and deny(): replace `if (row.status !== 'pending') return row;` with throwing a small typed error, e.g. `class BreakGlassNotPendingError extends Error { constructor(public status: string) { super('BREAK_GLASS_NOT_PENDING'); } }`. In health-service.ts's approveBreakGlass/denyBreakGlass, extend the existing catch block (which already special-cases the DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION message) to also catch BreakGlassNotPendingError and throw BusinessRuleError with a message like `Break-glass grant '${id}' is already '${error.status}' and cannot be re-approved/re-denied`.

PRC-L113 sub-issue 3 (mutate-on-read): in pg-break-glass-store.ts's findActiveGrant, delete the UPDATE health_phi_break_glass SET status='expired' statement that currently runs before every SELECT (the SELECT's own WHERE expires_at > $5 already excludes expired grants correctly without the sweep). Move the same sweep SQL into list() instead so status self-corrects to 'expired' on a write-adjacent path rather than the hot read path (findActiveGrant is called from resolveCaseNotesGrant on every counselling-session read).

PRC-L113 sub-issue 1 (approver-scope invariant, no behavior change): export TENANT_WIDE_HEALTH_ROLES from health-service.ts (currently a private const). Add a code comment next to HEALTH_BREAK_GLASS_APPROVER_ROLES in packages/backend/health/src/phi-field-acl.ts stating the invariant it depends on (every approver role must also be tenant-wide, or approve/deny need an institution-scope check added).

PRC-L113 tests: in packages/backend/health/src/phi-breakglass.test.ts (or a new break-glass-store.test.ts): (a) approve a pending grant, then call approve again on the same id — must throw BusinessRuleError (failing-first: currently returns 200 with the unchanged row); same for deny, and for approving an already-denied grant. (b) assert via a spy/mock on the pool/client query method that calling findActiveGrant does NOT send an UPDATE ... SET status='expired' statement (failing-first), while list() still performs the sweep (an approved-but-expired grant shows status:'expired' after calling list()). (c) a static regression assertion that HEALTH_BREAK_GLASS_APPROVER_ROLES.every(role => TENANT_WIDE_HEALTH_ROLES.includes(role)) holds.

Update packages/backend/health/src/in-memory-repository.ts and create-health-repository.ts only if the interface signature changes above (accessContext params added to screening-program methods) require it — ensure both still satisfy the HealthRepository/HealthService call shape so typecheck passes.
Run pnpm install at the worktree root first if node_modules is empty (check with `ls node_modules | wc -l` at the worktree root) — this is one-time environment setup, not part of any commit.
acceptance_criteria: A guardian-only HealthAccessContext (no authorized role) is rejected with ForbiddenError by every write method listed above and by requestBreakGlass, while the same context still succeeds on read methods.
A roles:[] or roles:['teacher'] context is rejected with ForbiddenError by all six screening-program service methods; a health_officer/health_admin context succeeds on all six.
A school-bound actor whose institution-lookup throws is denied access (not silently granted via JWT-claim fallback); a tenant-wide health_admin is unaffected by the same failure.
listCounsellingSessions/updateCounsellingSession return outcome:'' for non-counsellor, non-guardian viewers, and the real value for counsellors/guardians.
Approving or denying an already-resolved break-glass grant throws BusinessRuleError instead of returning 200 with the unchanged row.
findActiveGrant issues no UPDATE statement; list() still sweeps expired grants.
pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health test passes in full, including all new test files.
pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health run typecheck passes with no errors from the new accessContext parameters or TENANT_WIDE_HEALTH_ROLES export.
findings:
All steps implemented exactly as specified; no scope expansion. pnpm install at the worktree root succeeded cleanly (0 node_modules before install -> clean install, no errors, only the usual 'ignored build scripts' warning). Full `pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health test` is green: 170 passed, 6 skipped (the 6 skips are pre-existing it.skipIf(!isPgXEnabled()) live-Postgres suites unrelated to this FEAT). `pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health run typecheck` passes with zero errors. eslint/prettier clean on every file I touched (fixed one import/order error I introduced in health-service.ts; routes.ts has pre-existing unrelated warnings -- hardcoded i18n strings on lines untouched by this FEAT -- left alone). Live-Postgres verification NOT possible: `proctira-erp-postgres-1` container is up and accepting connections on 5434, but `pnpm --filter @proctira/database run prisma:migrate:deploy` against it fails with P3018 (`relation "attendance_audit" does not exist` in migration `20260908_wave7_rls_hardening`) -- a pre-existing migration-state issue on that shared container unrelated to this FEAT's health package. None of FEAT-001's new/changed tests require a live DB (break-glass-store.test.ts and break-glass-write-txn-audit.test.ts mock @proctira/database's withPgTenant directly), so this does not block FEAT-001's acceptance criteria, but FEAT-002's coder should know the shared test container's migration state is currently broken if any FEAT-002 step needs it.

Exact final signatures for FEAT-002:
- `hasHealthWriteAccess(context: HealthAccessContext, studentId: string, options?: HealthAccessOptions): boolean` (exported, in health-service.ts) -- same shape as hasHealthAccess but skips the guardian-of-student short-circuit.
- `assertHealthWriteAccess(accessContext, studentId, tenantId?)` is a private HealthService method (not exported) mirroring assertHealthAccess; throws ForbiddenError 'Access denied: not authorized to modify this student's health records'.
- `TENANT_WIDE_HEALTH_ROLES` is now exported (was a private const) -- used by break-glass-store.test.ts's static regression assertion and referenced from phi-field-acl.ts's doc comment. No rename.
- `BreakGlassNotPendingError` is exported from pg-break-glass-store.ts: `class BreakGlassNotPendingError extends Error { constructor(public status: string) }`, message is always the literal 'BREAK_GLASS_NOT_PENDING' (status is carried on the `.status` property, not the message) -- health-service.ts's approveBreakGlass/denyBreakGlass catch blocks check `error instanceof BreakGlassNotPendingError` and read `error.status`.
- `redactCounsellingReasons<T extends { studentId: string; reason: string; outcome: string | null }>` signature changed: `outcome` is now a required (non-optional) field on the generic constraint (it was previously only `{ studentId: string; reason: string }`). Every existing call site (updateCounsellingSession, listCounsellingSessions, exportStudentDsarPackage) already passes CounsellingSessionEntity[] which has `outcome: string | null`, so no call-site changes were needed -- but FEAT-002 should know the generic now requires `outcome` to be present on T, not optional.
- Screening-program service methods (createScreeningProgram, updateScreeningProgram, deleteScreeningProgram, getScreeningProgram, listScreeningPrograms, listScreeningProgramsByGrade) all gained a new `accessContext: HealthAccessContext` parameter -- positioned after the existing positional args and before the trailing `options?: { appendAuditInTxn }` object for create/update/delete. routes.ts's six screening-program handlers now call `getAccessContext(request)` and pass it through. The in-memory/hybrid repository (in-memory-repository.ts, create-health-repository.ts) and the Postgres store (pg-phi-store.ts) were NOT touched -- their method signatures are unchanged, only the HealthService layer gained the access-context parameter and a new private `assertScreeningProgramAccess` gate.
- pg-actor-institution-assignments.ts's findActorInstitutionAssignments no longer swallows query errors into `null` -- it now re-throws. Any other caller of this function (there is currently only one, HealthService.resolveAuthoritativeInstitutions) must wrap the call in try/catch or let the error propagate; resolveAuthoritativeInstitutions now catches it and returns `authoritativeInstitutionIds: []` for school-bound actors (deny), unchanged for tenant-wide actors.
- No NEEDS_DECISION items were encountered; PRC-L312's broader 'fail closed on every institution-lookup error' scope was deliberately NOT implemented, matching the step's explicit narrowing to only the findActorInstitutionAssignments path.
- Pre-existing tests I had to update for the new behavior (not new coverage, just signature/behavior alignment): health-service.test.ts's screening-program describe block (added accessContext arg to every call), its 'allows guardian to create measurement' test (renamed/inverted to assert ForbiddenError per PRC-L314), and its 'updates a counselling session' test (now asserts outcome is blanked for health_admin and the real value is still persisted, per PRC-M273). health-institution-authz.test.ts gained a new nested describe for PRC-L312's failing-first case using a ThrowingLookupRepository subclass of InMemoryHealthRepository.
